A daring crew explores ancient gates, contested systems, and civilizations poised for change.
Cross isolated star islands linked by unstable gates and old promises.
Resist or reform an empire powered by engineered suns and rigid duty.
Build a future along a dark frontier filled with relics and rival crews.
Navigate a hazardous route and rescue stranded crews
Resolve conflicting claims with evidence or force
Separate useful knowledge from a dangerous weapon
Award salvage, renown and a public consequence
Independent stations depend on a failing relay. Rescue stranded crews, bargain for fuel and decide who controls the only safe route.
A quarantine exposes the price of imperial stability. Inspect sealed cargo, negotiate conflicting orders and decide whether to reveal a dangerous treaty.
A dead beacon transmits tomorrow's distress call. Explore abandoned gates, question unreliable records and choose what knowledge the frontier should inherit.
A three to four hour Voidwake Archipelago game: Independent stations depend on a failing relay. Rescue stranded crews, bargain for fuel and decide who controls the only safe route.
Start with the tug drifting toward an occupied habitat.
Offer a fuel bargain whose cost is ownership, not simply money.
Let civilians propose alternatives to armed rescue.
Record who controls the repaired route and who pays its debts.
A three to four hour Sunforge Hegemony game: A quarantine exposes the price of imperial stability. Inspect sealed cargo, negotiate conflicting orders and decide whether to reveal a dangerous treaty.
Start with medicine sealed under contradictory orders.
Let the inspector be credible without making the military innocent.
Keep testimony, treatment and treaty access as separate objectives.
Record the agreement, reparations and anyone denied amnesty.

A three to four hour Nightglass Frontier game: A dead beacon transmits tomorrow's distress call. Explore abandoned gates, question unreliable records and choose what knowledge the frontier should inherit.
Play the future distress message before describing the empty beacon.
Distinguish rescued personal records from weapon targeting data.
Keep a stable return route available at a visible price.
Record which memories survive and who may access the archive.

Rescue Pilot: flies a damaged civilian tug and owes its crew a safe return.
Neutral Inspector: can read contradictory legal seals and has a relative in the sealed ward.

Union Medic: treats radiation exposure and needs the original shipment released.

Freewake Courier: knows blockade routes and wants them shared instead of auctioned.
Embassy Witness: preserves signed testimony and risks prosecution for an earlier seizure.
Route Steward: earns renown by keeping an evacuation route open; gain a courier contact and responsibility for repairs.

Gate Custodian: earns renown by recovering identities without leaking targeting data; gain archive access and consent duties.
